reason: My admin already types it all into Excel for free, and if I really wanted a Telegram bot I'd get someone to build one. I might let the free 30 run, but I'm not paying $19 to $35 a month just because the sheet is a week behind.

would_change_my_mind: If the free 30 showed it reading our handwritten mechanic notes and Indonesian fuel and parts receipts correctly, so my admin really stopped retyping and checking them.
